expected_level_description: You can: - set information governance policy and strategy - advise the board on information risk and compliance - represent the organisation with regulators and partners

You can: - set the organisation's data protection impact assessment process and standards - give the final advice on the highest-risk processing, such as large-scale data sharing or AI - consult regulators where the law requires it
You can: - own the organisation's information governance assurance framework - report assurance and compliance to the board and its committees - set improvement priorities based on risk
You can: - act as the senior adviser on confidentiality for the organisation - resolve the most difficult disclosure decisions - set the framework for sharing information with partners
You can: - run the governance cycle for boards and committees - review policies and advise on compliance
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession

You can: - oversee compliance with data ethics standards and legislation across the organisation - develop, manage and continuously improve an ethical framework within your area - develop a data ethics culture, influencing others to act on it - ensure data ethics is applied appropriately when formulating, implementing and evaluating organisational policies and programmes

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
